name: particle-academy/fancy-passkeys
description: Passkey (WebAuthn) login for PHP — a thin, safe wrapper around web-auth/webauthn-lib that owns the parts it deliberately leaves to you: challenge issuance, single-use expiry, credential persistence, counter replay detection. Framework-free core plus a Laravel bridge that augments Fortify.

suggest.illuminate/support: Only needed for the optional Laravel bridge — service provider, Eloquent credential store, migrations, routes, and the Fortify-compatible login controller. Compatible with 11.x through 13.x. The framework-free PasskeyServer needs none of it.
suggest.laravel/fortify: Passkey login registers alongside Fortify's routes and authenticates on Fortify's configured guard, so an app keeps password login, reset, and 2FA untouched.
